summary: Frontend changes implement a non-blocking profile setup prompt/modal and add a current-user hook with a default non-admin role fallback. Backend changes relax profile read/save authorization for authenticated (non-anonymous) callers. However, the diff does not show an implementation of the backend role API (getCallerUserRole), and the new profile UI appears to allow self-selecting an 'admin' role, which was not requested and conflicts with the non-goal of not granting admin privileges by default.

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide a backend role API used by the frontend (e.g., getCallerUserRole) that does not reject first-time authenticated users and returns a sensible default role (e.g., "user").
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend now calls actor.getCallerUserRole(), but the backend diff excerpt only shows profile methods and does not show any getCallerUserRole (or equivalent) implementation or its relaxed authorization/default behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Allowing the user to choose 'admin' as their role during profile setup (self-assigning admin).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly notes a non-goal of not granting admin privileges to everyone by default; adding an onboarding UI that lets any authenticated user set their role to 'admin' is an unrequested capability and undermines role-based access control.
